# Error codes services/public-api sends, with the HTTP status each is sent with.
#
# Generated from every apierror.Respond call in services/public-api/internal
# (the first upper-case string literal is the code, http.Status* the status).
# test/public_api_error_codes_test.dart re-derives this list from the Go
# sources and fails when it drifts; every code here must have Portuguese copy
# in lib/utils/error_messages.dart, or be one the status class already words
# correctly (see that test's statusClassCodes).
#
# Codes public-api passes through from core rather than naming in a
# Respond call (the Sandbox top-up refusal, handler/sandbox.go
# sandboxCreditRefusal) are listed with the `passthrough` marker.
ACCOUNT_FROZEN 422
BAD_REQUEST 400
CONSUMER_NOT_FOUND 404
DUPLICATE_WALLET 409
EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE 409
FCM_ERROR 502
FORBIDDEN 403
HANDLE_TAKEN 409
IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED 409
INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS 422
INTERNAL_ERROR 500
INVALID_AMOUNT 400
INVALID_BODY 400
INVALID_CREDENTIALS 401
INVALID_FIELD 400
INVALID_HANDLE 400
INVALID_INPUT 400
INVALID_LIFECYCLE_STATE 422
INVALID_PARAM 400
INVALID_RECIPIENT 400
INVALID_STATE 409
INVALID_TOKEN 401
LINK_ALREADY_PAID 409
LINK_NOT_ACTIVE 422
METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED 405
MISSING_FIELD 400
NOT_FOUND 404
NO_WALLET 404
NO_WALLET 422
OBJECT_NOT_UPLOADED 409
ONBOARDING_NOT_FOUND 404
OTP_EXPIRED 422
OTP_INVALID 422
PAYMENT_NOT_CONFIRMED 502
PIN_POLICY_FAILED 400
RATE_LIMITED 429
RECEIPT_UNAVAILABLE 503
RECIPIENT_NOT_FOUND 404
RECIPIENT_UNAVAILABLE 422
SANDBOX_ONLY 403
SELF_TRANSFER_NOT_ALLOWED 400
SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE 503
STORAGE_NOT_CONFIGURED 503
TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS 429
TRANSFER_FAILED 500
UNAUTHORIZED 401
UNSUPPORTED_CURRENCY 400
VALIDATION_ERROR 400
WALLET_LOCKED 403
WALLET_NOT_FOUND 422
SANDBOX_CREDIT_REFUSED 422 passthrough
PILOT_LIMIT_AGGREGATE_FUNDS_EXCEEDED 422 passthrough
PILOT_LIMIT_AGGREGATE_VOLUME_EXCEEDED 422 passthrough
